Interface AdaptiveMealyBuilder<I,O>

Type Parameters:
I - input symbol type
O - output symbol type
All Superinterfaces:

public interface AdaptiveMealyBuilder<I,O> extends MealyBuilder<I,O>
A variation of the IncrementalMealyBuilder interface that allows one to override previously inserted traces.
